Shipped Local AI

Behind the local-AI cluster batch one

The first cluster batch adds three long guides that fit the existing templates: which quantization level for which card, how to keep embeddings resident on a consumer GPU, and a full local retrieval walkthrough. Each guide links to its cluster siblings and the topic hub, each glossary term links back, and the deterministic build plus the full test suite pass.

The first local-AI cluster batch shipped as three guides plus this log entry in the same pull request. This entry records the trail; review verdicts and deployment evidence are recorded in the linked review and deploy threads.

Motivation

The local-AI topic needed a connected core: one guide that sizes quantized models per card, one that keeps embeddings resident beside the chat model, and one that joins both into a grounded retrieval loop. The three link to each other, to the glossary terms they extend, and to the topic hub, so readers can walk the whole arc without search. The live guides are quantized models explained, embeddings on consumer GPUs, and RAG on your own machine.

What changed

Three new long guides joined the journal, each with its distribution pack for social and feed syndication. The quantization, embeddings and retrieval glossary entries each gained a short passage pointing at their guide, completing the both-ways linking. The reserved comparison post is mentioned by name in planning only, with no hard link until it merges, and the two older shelf posts keep their pinned bodies untouched while the new guides link toward them.

How it was done

Each guide was drafted from the existing post scaffold with no template or navigation changes, keeping the content-only scope the triage set. Every memory and speed figure cites a primary source next to the claim, and no benchmark was invented. The deterministic site build regenerated the journal indexes, the topic hub, the feed, the sitemap and the search index, and the full test suite passed on the branch head before the pull request opened.

Agent trail

Director scoped the batch to three guides with design review skipped as content only. Implementation drafted the guides, wired the glossary backlinks, added the distribution packs, rebuilt the site and ran the gates. Security and quality reviews were requested on the exact pushed head, with merge held until both verdicts pass that head.

Verification evidence

Security and quality sign-off on the reviewed head; the merge carries three guides to the main branch. Every source link returned success when checked before publication, and the deterministic site build plus the full test suite passed. HTTP logs and full review text are recorded in the linked review thread.
